title: Analysis of mitochondrial double-stranded RNAs in human cells
protocol: Coat a confocal dish with 1 mL of 0.1% gelatin.
Incubate the coated dish in a humid 37°C incubator with 5% CO2 for 18 h.
Aspirate the gelatin from the dish.
Wash the dish once with cell culture medium.
Seed 1 × 10^5 cells on the confocal dish in 1 mL of cell culture medium.
Incubate the seeded cells in a 37°C incubator with 5% CO2 for 18 h.
Wash cells once with PBS pre-warmed to 37°C.
Add 1 mL of 4% paraformaldehyde and incubate cells for 10 min at 20-25°C.
Rinse cells twice with PBS.
Permeabilize cells in 1 mL of 0.1% Triton X-100 in PBS for 10 min at 20-25°C.
Rinse cells twice with PBST.
Make PBST by adding 1 mL of Tween-20 to 1 L of PBS one day prior to the experiment.
Mix 1 mL of 1% bovine serum albumin (BSA) in PBST and incubate cells for 1 hour at 20°C–25°C.
Filter the 1% BSA solution with a 0.22 μm filter to remove precipitants before use.
Remove the filtered BSA solution after incubation.
Add 200 μL of J2 antibody diluted 1:100 in 1% BSA and incubate for 2 hours at 20°C–25°C.
Rinse cells with PBST twice.
Wash cells with PBST three times, each wash lasting 10 minutes at 20°C–25°C.
Add 200 μL of secondary antibody mixture and incubate for 45 minutes at 20°C–25°C.
Protect the sample from light during all future steps to avoid photobleaching.
Rinse cells with PBST twice after incubation.
Wash cells with PBST three times, each wash lasting 10 minutes at 20°C–25°C.
Detach the cover glass from the confocal dish carefully without breaking it.
Place 10–20 μL of mounting solution on a new microscope slide.
Position the cover glass onto the microscope slide containing the mounting solution.
Press lightly on any area with bubbles to release air and avoid high autofluorescence.
Seal the edges of the cover glass with clear nail polish.
Air-dry for 5 min at 20°C–25°C.
Store the sample in a light-protective box and keep it at 4°C for 18 h.
Observe the cells using a confocal microscope with a 63× objective.
Capture images of the observed cells.
Seed 2 × 10^4 cells on an 8-chamber slide in 200 μL of cell culture medium.
Incubate the seeded slide in a humid 37°C incubator with 5% CO2 for 18 hours.
Wash cells once with cold (4°C) PBS.
Remove PBS and add 200 μL of 4% paraformaldehyde per each well.
Incubate the cells in paraformaldehyde for 10 minutes at 20°C–25°C.
Rinse cells twice with PBS.
Submerge the slide in 80 mL of 50% ethanol for 5 minutes at 20°C–25°C.
Replace the solution with 80 mL of 70% ethanol and submerge the slide for 5 minutes at 20°C–25°C.
Replace the solution with 80 mL of 100% ethanol and submerge the slide for 5 minutes at 20°C–25°C.
Submerge the slide in fresh 100% ethanol for 10 minutes at 20°C–25°C.
Submerge the slide in 70% ethanol for 2 minutes at 20°C–25°C.
Replace the solution with 80 mL of 50% ethanol and submerge the slide for 2 minutes at 20°C–25°C.
Replace the solution with PBS and submerge the slide for 10 minutes at 20°C–25°C.
Draw a boundary around each well with a hydrophobic barrier pen and dry the barrier for about 30 seconds.
Rinse slides with PBS.
Prepare diluted protease III.
Drop 60 μL of diluted protease III on each well.
Incubate for 10 minutes at 20°C–25°C.
Warm up the humidity control tray (PN310012) of the HybEZ II hybridization system with wet paper towels at 40°C.
Warm probes for 10 minutes at 40°C in the hybridization system.
Wash the slide glass twice with PBS.
Prepare a probe mixture.
Vortex the probe mixture for 5 seconds.
Spin down the probe mixture.
Remove excess liquid from the slide glass carefully without shaking off cells.
Drop 80 μL of mixed probe on each well of the HybEZ slide rack.
Close the tray and incubate in the humid HybEZ II hybridization system at 40°C for 2 h.
Remove the tray from the hybridization system after incubation.
Wash the slides in the RNAscope single-molecule RNA-FISH wash buffer for 2 min at 20°C–25°C.
Repeat the wash step once more.
Warm Amp 1-FL for 5 min at 40°C in the hybridization system.
Remove excess liquid from the slide.
Add 2 drops (around 60 μL) of Amp 1-FL to each well.
Incubate the tray in the hybridization system at 40°C for 30 min.
Warm Amp 2-FL for 5 min at 40°C in the hybridization system.
Remove the tray from the hybridization system and submerge the slides in the wash buffer for 2 min at 20°C–25°C.
Repeat the wash step once more.
Remove excess liquid from the slide.
Add 2 drops of Amp 2-FL to each well.
Incubate the tray in the hybridization system at 40°C for 15 min.
Warm Amp 3-FL for 5 min at 40°C in the hybridization system.
Remove the tray from the hybridization oven and submerge the slides in the wash buffer for 2 min at 20°C–25°C.
Repeat the wash step once more.
Remove excess liquid from the slide.
Add 2 drops of Amp 3-FL to each well.
Close the tray and incubate it in the hybridization system at 40°C for 30 min.
Warm Amp 4-FL-Alt C for 5 min at 40°C in the hybridization system.
Remove the tray from the hybridization system and submerge the slides in the wash buffer for 2 min at 20°C–25°C.
Repeat the wash step once more.
Remove excess liquid from the slide.
Put the slide back into the slide rack.
Add 2 drops of Amp 4-FL-Alt C to each well.
Close the tray and incubate it in the hybridization system at 40°C for 15 min.
Submerge the slides in the wash buffer for 2 min at 20°C–25°C after removing the tray.
Repeat the wash step once more.
Add 80 μL of the mitochondria staining mixture to each well.
Incubate for 15 min at 20°C–25°C.
Wash the slide twice for 2 min with PBST in a 10 μL pipette tip tray.
Add a drop (around 10 μL) of mounting solution on each well and place the cover glass on top, avoiding bubbles.
Seal the edges with clear nail polish.
Air-dry for 5 min at 20°C–25°C.
Store the sample in a light-protective box and keep it at 4°C for 18 h.
Remove all RNases and fine dust from the workbench by wiping it with 10% bleach followed by 70% ethanol.
Seed cells in an appropriate dish.
After trypsinization, transfer 3 × 10^5 cells in 1 mL of culture medium to a 6-well plate.
Incubate cells in a humidified incubator at 37°C with 5% CO2.
Aspirate the culture medium from the wells.
Add 1 mL/well of TRIzol directly onto cells grown in a 6-well plate.
Suspend the solution by pipetting up and down until all cells are dissolved in TRIzol, then transfer the solution into a 1.7 mL microcentrifuge tube.
Add 200 μL of chloroform to the tube.
Vortex the solution thoroughly for 30 seconds.
Centrifuge the sample at 13,523 × g for 15 minutes at 4°C.
Carefully transfer the supernatant to a 1.5 mL G-Tube.
Avoid touching the middle layer to prevent contamination that may compromise RNA quality.
Use a 200 μL tip to carefully and thoroughly remove the aqueous layer.
Add 600 μL of an isopropanol mixture solution.
Vortex for 5 s.
Incubate the sample at −20°C for 18 h.
Centrifuge the sample at 21,130 × g for at least 1 h at 4°C.
Remove the supernatant and wash the pellet with 1 mL of 75% ethanol at 13,523 × g for 5 min at 4°C.
Remove the supernatant and repeat the wash step.
Air-dry for 15 min at 20°C–25°C.
Spin down the tube and remove remaining ethanol with 200 μL and 10 μL tips combined to minimize drying time.
Add 42 μL of RNase-free water to the sample and dissolve the pellet thoroughly by pipetting.
Add 8 μL of a DNase I mixture solution.
Mix the solution by tapping and spin down the sample.
Incubate the sample in a 37°C heat block for 30 min.
Add 150 μL of RNase-free water and 200 μL of acid-phenol.
Vortex vigorously for 30 seconds.
Centrifuge the sample at 13,523 × g for 5 minutes at 20°C–25°C.
Transfer 200 μL of supernatant to a fresh G-tube.
Add 1 mL of 100% ethanol to the sample.
Add 20 μL of sodium acetate (pH 5.5) to the mixture.
Add 0.5 μL of GlycoBlue to the solution.
Vortex for 5 seconds.
Incubate the sample at −80°C for 18 hours.
Centrifuge the sample at 21,130 × g for at least 1 hour at 4°C.
Remove the supernatant from the sample.
Wash the RNA pellet with 75% ethanol at 13,523 × g for 5 minutes at 4°C.
Repeat the wash step to remove all supernatant.
Air-dry the pellet for 15 minutes at 20°C–25°C.
Dissolve the RNA pellet in 30 μL of RNase-free water.
Run 1 μg of intact and degraded total RNAs extracted from HEK-293T cells on a 1.5% agarose gel.
Detect 28S and 18S ribosomal RNA (rRNA) bands by EtBr staining.
Determine the intensity ratio (28S rRNA/18S rRNA).
Store RNA samples at −80°C for up to one year if needed.

Compare various types of reverse transcription primer (RTP) tags based on sequences from SP6, cytomegalovirus (CMV), and glutathione S-transferase (GST) promoters while optimizing strand-specific RT-qPCR.
Use Cq values of the abundant housekeeping gene Glyceraldehyde-3-phosphate dehydrogenase (GAPDH) mRNA to verify reverse transcription (RT) and PCR amplification efficiency.
Prepare 4 μM RTP stock by mixing 1 μL of each 100 μM primer with 96 μL triple distilled water (TDW).
Heat the strand-specific RT pre-mixture solution at 65°C for 5 minutes.
Cool the sample to 4°C after heating.
Add 7 μL of a strand-specific RT second mixture solution to the cooled pre-mixture.
Incubate the sample in a PCR machine according to the specified procedure.
Prepare a 3 μM qPCR primer mix by adding 3 μL of target (sense or antisense) and tag-only qPCR primer stock (100 μM) to 94 μL triple distilled water (TDW).
For multiple samples, multiply each volume by the number of samples required.
Use a target sequence as the forward primer and a tag-only sequence as the reverse primer.
Add 14 μL of strand-specific qPCR pre-mixture to each well of a 96-well PCR plate.
Carefully add 1 μL of cDNA to each well containing the pre-mixture.
Seal the PCR plate with an optical adhesive film.
Spin down the plate for 30 s using a centrifuge to remove bubbles.
Centrifuge the plate again for 5 s.
